text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: A "personality type diagnostic"?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
You know, the craze sweeping the Academy right now.
Youngsters are awfully fond of finding themselves, after all.
Which means young maidens like us are—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Fine, let me rephrase! Deepening our self-understanding
might yield some useful data, you know!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
The trendy shit has zero empirical backing.
In other words, it's useless garbage.
You already know that damn well.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Oho! So that means you...
"prioritize logic over emotion"?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Obviously...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Huh? You bastard—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
How strange, though.
A few days ago, you were—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Ah?! Energy drinks sold out?!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
That godawwwwful tasting slop?!
...Who the hell's buying it! Tch!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
After cursing it out to such an extreme extent?
And you claim you aren't emotional! My, what a surprise!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Now then, how about "drawing attention"?
Does it "bother you"?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Don't give a damn—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
You don't give a damn?! How very odd.
Then what was that spectacle I witnessed earlier?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Hm? That girl...
Wearing my T-shirt—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I assumed you changed paths back there
because you didn't want to get spotted by a fan, though.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
............I was just avoiding a hassle.
I don't give a shit about attention itself.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Meaning you "find it difficult to interact
with strangers"... perhaps?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Huh? It ain't difficult.
It's just a pain in the ass.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
In that case, Shakur-kun!
"What is your guiding principle"—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
—Like I said!
There's a point to doing things in order, dammit.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
The most optimal path gets decided from the start.
Then following it is the only thing that makes sense!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I see.
"Proceed with things in proper sequence"... is it?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Alright, that's it~!
Diagnosis complete!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you simply can't let a misconception go uncorrected.
You're truly a scholar at heart.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Now then, the result is...
"A lone wolf charging forward on its own path," hmm?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Hah.
State the obvious, why don't you.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Linear, just like an equation... is it?
Hmph...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
...Even so,
it should serve as at least one decent sample.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
It's a fine opportunity to objectively reinterpret oneself.
To flesh it out... jumping on current trends and using AI could be quite intriguing.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Still... fufu.
A lone wolf, of all things... fufufu.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While walking through the academy grounds,
I spotted Air Shakur and Agnes Tachyon.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
By the way, what kind of personality type
did you think I'd get?
—Mr. Lone Wolf.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
......
A freakin' mad bastard.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Come now, isn't that just judging by appearances?
Give me something that points to my true nature—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Going all-in on an uncertain variable like 'potential'.
You're nothing but a damn mad romanticist.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
...In conclusion, we're two birds of a feather.
Mr. Bitter Mad Realist.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Walking down the hallway...
I ran into Agnes Tachyon chasing after Air Shakur.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Wait for me,
Mr. Lone Wolf~!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Oh, you're angry? Yet you won't show any emotion...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Could it be because you answered earlier that you prioritize reason?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Heeey, I'm taking your silence as a yes~!
Wolf-kun~?
